title: Chishuwo muImba Tsvene
intro: Unopinda munzvimbo tsvene yakanyarara woona mushumiri waAllah akazvipira akamira achinyengetera. Maoko avo akasimudzwa, maziso avo akasimudzwa, uye mwoyo yavo ine chishuwo chagara kwenguva refu. Ndiani mweya uyu une mwoyo murefu une chivimbo munaAllah chisina kumbozununguka?
clues: Ndakapedza makore akawanda ndichinamata uye ndichinyengetera, ndichiona zvishamiso zvakasimbisa kutenda kwangu.
Ndakapiwa basa rekutarisira mweya wechidiki wakaropafadzwa munzvimbo tsvene.
Pandakakura, kusuruvara kwangu kukuru kwaiva kuti handina mwana, nekuti mudzimai wangu akanga asina mbereko uye tese takanga takwegura.
Ndakanyengetera kuna Ishe wangu kuti ndiwane mutsivi kubva kumhuri yangu, munhu aizoenderera mberi nenhaka yehuporofita.
Pandakamira panzvimbo yekunamatira, ngirozi dzakandidana, dzichiti, 'Allah vanokupa mashoko akanaka', uye ndakatya zvikuru.
Ndakaudzwa kuti ndaizova nemwanakomana anonzi Yahya, zita rakanga risati rambopiwa chero ani zvake, uye sechiratidzo ndaisazotaura nevanhu kwemazuva matatu.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
